records.title: Dependency-Aware Semi-Structured Sparsity: Declining Roles of Outliers in Pruning GLU-based LLMs
records.reason: DaSS prunes GLU-based LLMs (LLaMA2/Mistral/Gemma) with a dependency-aware semi-structured metric combining weight magnitude and MLP intermediate activation norms, explicitly targeting serving memory size and token-generation latency with hardware-friendly N:M sparsity patterns outperforming SparseGPT and Wanda.

records.title: Adaptive Inverse Transform Sampling For Efficient Vision Transformers
records.reason: Adaptive Token Sampling inserts a parameter-free module into vision transformers that scores tokens by class-token attention and samples a per-image token count, halving GFLOPs on ImageNet/video classification; it is token-reduction for ViT inference efficiency, but the target is vision classification rather than LLM inference.

records.title: Arabic Compact Language Modelling for Resource Limited Devices
records.reason: Trains a compact Arabic BERT-style language model for resource-limited devices and applies distillation and quantization to shrink it further (largest model 2x smaller than baseline with better task scores); on-device motivation is real, but the contribution is language-model training for Arabic NLP, not an inference system or measured serving technique.

records.title: RECAP: Training-Free Compensation for Coarse Activation Channel Pruning in Compressed LLMs
records.reason: RECAP compensates training-free for coarse activation-channel pruning in compressed LLMs: it estimates the activation error from removing a channel and transfers it into the corresponding weights with grouped outlier-robust statistics, restoring LLaMA3-8B BoolQ accuracy from 38.75% to 72.48% at 70% activation-channel sparsity while keeping hardware-friendly channel sparsity.

records.title: TF-MAS: Training-free Mamba2 Architecture Search
records.reason: TF-MAS is a training-free neural architecture search for Mamba2 that scores candidate SSD-block architectures with a rank-collapse proxy over transformation matrices; it searches model architectures for accuracy, with no inference system, serving, or deployment measurement.

records.title: LLM-Guided Autoscheduling for Large-Scale Sparse Machine Learning
records.reason: Autosparse uses an LLM to propose fusion groupings and legal dataflow orders inside a sparse-ML compiler for GCN/GraphSAGE workloads; the LLM is a search tool for sparse tensor scheduling, and there is no contribution to LLM inference, serving, or decoding.

records.title: A Black-Box Graph Partitioner for Generalized Deep Neural Network Parallelization
records.reason: BBGraP is a model- and device-agnostic black-box graph partitioner that generates data-parallel execution plans for deep-learning inference across heterogeneous nodes, removing redundant transfers and synchronization for a 30% latency reduction on three nodes; it is distributed inference partitioning, but demonstrated only as a proof of concept on generic DNNs, not LLMs.

records.title: Less is More: Improving LLM Reasoning with Minimal Test-Time Intervention
records.reason: Minimal Test-Time Intervention detects high-entropy tokens during reasoning and applies selective classifier-free guidance only there, reusing the main model's KV cache to approximate the unconditional branch cheaply; it is a decoding-time algorithm, but its measured contribution is reasoning accuracy (+9.28% average) rather than inference-system performance.

records.title: 2.5-dimensional Distributed Model Training
records.reason: SUMMA2.5-LM proposes 2.5-dimensional tensor parallelism that cuts per-layer transmission cost for distributed language-model training (1.45x weak-scaling efficiency over 2D); the work is entirely about training parallelization, not inference or serving.

records.title: RGP: Achieving Memory-Efficient Model Fine-tuning Via Randomized Gradient Projection
records.reason: RGP projects gradients with random matrices to cut optimizer-state memory during LLM fine-tuning, beating GaLore on GLUE while training 74% faster; it optimizes the training/fine-tuning loop and makes no inference or serving contribution.

records.title: Mixture of Virtual Prompts: Efficient Fine-tuning with Virtual Prompts for Natural Language Understanding
records.reason: Mixture of Virtual Prompts learns sets of virtual prompts of distinct capacities and dynamically aggregates them to adapt frozen pre-trained models to NLU tasks with 0.03% of parameters; this is parameter-efficient fine-tuning for task adaptation, not inference efficiency or serving.

records.title: Efficient and performant Transformer private inference with heterogeneous attention mechanisms
records.reason: EPTI-style private Transformer inference under secure two-party secret sharing replaces expensive Softmax/GELU evaluations with specialized operator approximations (Multiplicative Residual Softmax), cutting communication volume 10.2-25.4% and end-to-end latency up to 41.7% on WAN emulation; it targets private-inference efficiency for generic Transformers rather than LLM serving specifically.

records.title: Fresh Memory, Stale Plans: Dependency-Scoped Validation for Distributed LLM-Agent Memory
records.reason: PlanFence is a dependency-scoped validation protocol for distributed LLM-agent shared memory: plans cite their input records and executors validate only action-relevant dependencies before acting, eliminating stale-plan execution in 30 five-agent workflows; it concerns agent coordination correctness, not model inference systems.

records.title: Scalable Binary-Quantized Neural Networks for Energy-Efficient Vision
records.reason: Proposes a Tower architecture and unified training scheme for vision networks with integer weights/activations down to binary, plus a refined resource-usage estimation methodology; binary quantization is inference-relevant, but the contribution is training vision models and no LLM or serving evaluation is provided.

records.title: Meta-Learning at Scale for Large Language Models via Low-Rank Amortized Bayesian Meta-Learning
records.reason: ABMLL amortizes Bayesian meta-learning into LoRA variables so LLMs can be adapted to multiple datasets for few-shot generalization (CrossFit/Unified-QA); it is a fine-tuning/meta-learning method for training-time adaptation, with no inference-system or serving contribution.

records.title: DiffuGR: Generative Document Retrieval with Diffusion Language Models
records.reason: DiffuGR reframes generative document retrieval as discrete diffusion over DocIDs, generating tokens in parallel with a controllable number of denoising steps that explicitly trades retrieval quality against latency at inference; the decoding mechanism is inference-relevant, but the contribution is a retrieval application, not LLM serving.

records.title: Key Factor Selection Transformer for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
records.reason: Key Factor Selection Transformer forecasts multivariate time series (transportation, meteorology, finance) with a two-stage variable-selection network, Prob-sparse self-attention and a GRU; it is a forecasting application model with no LLM inference or serving content.

records.title: Unseen Horizons: Unveiling the Real Capability of LLM Code Generation Beyond the Familiar
records.reason: OBFusEval benchmarks LLM code-generation capability using three-level code obfuscation over 1,354 cases from five real projects to avoid training-data familiarity; it evaluates model capability and does not touch inference systems, decoding, or serving.

records.title: PlanEval: Augmenting Large Language Models With a Small-Scale Planner-Evaluator for Knowledge-Intensive Tasks
records.reason: PlanEval offloads planning and retrieval evaluation to a small-scale planner-evaluator model so the LLM is invoked less for knowledge-intensive multi-step tasks, motivated by the cost and edge-deployment latency of LLM-heavy prompting; the contribution is a task-level agent framework, not an inference-system mechanism.

records.title: LF Transformer: A novel lightweight network for machine translation
records.reason: LF Transformer is a lightweight dual-branch funnel-structured network designed for machine translation that reduces parameter count and the computational load of training and inference; it is a task-specific NMT architecture rather than a general LLM inference or serving technique.

records.title: Bias-Aware Low-Rank Adaptation: Mitigating Catastrophic Inheritance of Large Language Models
records.reason: BA-LoRA decomposes LoRA's catastrophic inheritance of pre-training bias into knowledge drift, representation collapse and overfitting, and mitigates it during parameter-efficient fine-tuning; it is about fine-tuning quality/fairness, with no inference or serving contribution.

records.title: Efficient transformer with reinforced position embedding for language models
records.reason: Concatenates reinforced positional embeddings with token embeddings and reuses the normalized embedding matrix as attention values in a small encoder-decoder Transformer, improving training/validation loss and epoch time on Portuguese-English translation; the efficiency measured is training time for a translation model, not LLM inference.

records.title: K-MSHC: Unmasking Minimally Sufficient Head Circuits in Large Language Models with Experiments on Syntactic Classification Tasks
records.reason: K-MSHC identifies minimally sufficient attention-head circuits in Gemma-9B for grammar acceptability and arithmetic tasks and analyzes cross-task head overlap; it is mechanistic interpretability of model internals, with no inference acceleration, compression, or serving mechanism.

records.title: LLMs for LLMs: A Structured Prompting Methodology for Long Legal Documents
records.reason: Applies structured prompting with document chunking/augmentation and distribution-based candidate selection heuristics to Qwen-2 for information retrieval over long CUAD legal contracts; a legal-domain prompting application, not an inference system.

records.title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Recurrent Neural Networks
records.reason: QRNN realizes the recurrent core as a parametrized quantum circuit whose unitary hidden state is read out via mid-circuit Pauli expectations, evaluated in simulation on sentiment, MNIST and translation; a quantum model architecture study with no LLM inference-system relevance.

records.title: Automated Code Generation Algorithm Using GPT-Based Language Models for Secure Software Development
records.reason: Presents a GPT-based automated code-generation algorithm combining prompt engineering, reinforcement learning and fine-tuning on programming datasets, plus a code validation module for secure software development; an application of LLMs to coding, not an inference system.

records.title: Enhancing Abstraction in Large Language Models Through Nature-Inspired Semantic Patterns
records.reason: Proposes enhancing LLM abstraction by mapping a fourfold nature-inspired semantic pattern (Kn/Po/Pr/H) onto language structure to improve theme recognition and implicit inference; a conceptual NLP proposal with no inference, serving, or efficiency mechanism.

records.title: Hierarchical Multi-Modal Transformer for Cross-Modal Long Document Classification
records.reason: HMT fuses text and image features hierarchically with a dynamic mask transfer module for cross-modal long document classification on newly built datasets; a multimodal classification model, not an inference or serving contribution.

records.title: Let your LLM generate a few tokens and you will reduce the need for retrieval
records.reason: Distills an LLM-as-judge into an IK (I Know) classifier that decides whether a RAG query needs retrieval, cutting search/reranking steps by over 50% at 80% accuracy; it is a RAG gating classifier trained by distillation, not an inference-system technique.

records.title: Supernova: Achieving More with Less in Transformer Architectures
records.reason: Supernova is a 650M decoder-only model combining RoPE, 3:1 GQA and a custom 128k BPE tokenizer to reach 90% of 1B-model performance with 35% fewer parameters and 100B training tokens; GQA/tokenizer choices are inference-relevant, but the paper reports model quality versus training budget, not inference latency or serving behavior.

records.title: LieTransformer: Equivariant self-attention for Lie Groups
records.reason: LieTransformer builds Lie-group-equivariant self-attention layers and evaluates on point-cloud shape counting, molecular property regression and Hamiltonian particle trajectories; a geometric deep-learning architecture for science applications, unrelated to LLM inference.

records.title: SWE-Master: Unleashing the Potential of Software Engineering Agents via Post-Training
records.reason: SWE-Master is a reproducible post-training framework (trajectory synthesis, long-horizon SFT, RL with execution feedback) that raises Qwen2.5-Coder-32B to 61.4% on SWE-bench Verified; despite mentioning inference framework design, the contribution is agent post-training, not inference systems.

records.title: Structured Episodic Event Memory
records.reason: SEEM organizes LLM-agent long-term memory into graph relational facts plus episodic event frames with reverse provenance expansion, improving LoCoMo/LongMemEval narrative coherence; it is an agent memory/retrieval framework, not the model's inference memory or serving stack.

records.title: RouteMoA: Dynamic Routing without Pre-Inference Boosts Efficient Mixture-of-Agents
records.reason: RouteMoA routes queries in a Mixture-of-Agents pool with a lightweight scorer that screens candidate models before any inference and a judge mixture that corrects scores, cutting MoA cost by 89.8% and latency by 63.6% in large pools; it is inference-time model routing at the agent-framework level rather than a serving system for a model.

records.title: D2Pruner: Debiased Importance and Structural Diversity for MLLM Token Pruning
records.reason: D2Pruner prunes visual tokens in MLLMs by combining a debiased attention-based importance score with maximal-independent-set selection over a spatial-semantic hybrid graph, reducing LLaVA-1.5-7B FLOPs by 74.2% while retaining 99.2% performance and sustaining 85.7% at 90% token reduction on InternVL localization; a direct inference-acceleration technique for multimodal LLMs.

records.title: HGMEM: Hypergraph-based Working Memory to Improve Multi-step RAG for Long-Context Complex Relational Modeling
records.reason: HGMEM represents RAG working memory as a hypergraph whose hyperedges link facts and thoughts for multi-step relational reasoning over long contexts; it targets reasoning quality in retrieval pipelines, not inference efficiency or serving.

records.title: InfoSeeker: A Scalable Hierarchical Parallel Agent Framework for Web Information Seeking
records.reason: InfoSeeker organizes web information-seeking agents into Host/Manager/parallel Worker layers with context isolation, reporting 3-5x task-execution speedup on WideSearch/BrowseComp; the parallelism is agent workflow orchestration, not model inference.

records.title: SearchArt: Training Long-Horizon Search Agent with Scalable Synthetic and Verified Task
records.reason: SearchArt synthesizes verified long-horizon search tasks and trajectories from web documents and evidence graphs, then trains search agents with SFT plus RL; a training-data and post-training framework for agents, not inference.

records.title: FLAME: Flow Enhanced Legendre Memory Models for General Time Series Forecasting
records.reason: FLAME is a lightweight time-series foundation model family using translated/scaled Legendre memory and a normalizing-flow forecasting head, benchmarked on TSFM-Bench/ProbTS/TFB; a forecasting application model unrelated to LLM inference systems.

records.title: Cut Less, Fold More: Model Compression through the Lens of Projection Geometry
records.reason: Formalizes structured pruning as axis-aligned projection and model folding as low-rank projection via weight clustering, proving folding's smaller reconstruction error within rank distance one and validating on 1000+ checkpoints of ResNet/ViT/CLIP plus small 60M/130M LLaMA models; compression theory relevant to inference, but LLM evidence is limited to tiny models and no latency is measured.

records.title: Squeezer: Efficient Multi-DNN Inference for Edge Video Analytics via Cross-Model Scheduling
records.reason: Squeezer is a serving framework that holistically schedules multiple DNN models for edge video analytics on a single GPU, decoupling cross-model scheduling into balanced operator grouping and model-level scheduling; it is genuine inference serving/scheduling, but for vision DNN pipelines rather than LLMs.

records.title: Temporal Order Matters for Agentic Memory: Segment Trees for Long-Horizon Agents
records.reason: SegTreeMem stores conversation history in a temporally ordered segment tree over utterances and propagates retrieval relevance through the hierarchy for long-horizon conversational agents; an external agent-memory retrieval design, not model inference memory or serving.

records.title: High-Accuracy, High-Performance In-Memory Computing With High-Resistance Spin-Orbit Torque (SOT) Magnetic Memory
records.reason: Demonstrates 1-bit quantized networks on spin-orbit-torque MRAM in-memory-computing arrays, addressing device variation, IR drop and program-verify overhead at the circuit/device level; it is memory-device research for generic AI accelerators, not an LLM inference system contribution.

records.title: Towards Compressive and Scalable Recurrent Memory
records.reason: Elastic Memory uses HiPPO-based online compression to encode history into a fixed-size recurrent state with polynomial-sampling retrieval, beating Memorizing Transformer with 16x less memory on 32k+ context tasks and running faster than Melodi at 4x scale; a long-context memory architecture relevant to inference cost, but evaluated as a model architecture rather than a serving system.

records.title: MEME: Multi-entity & Evolving Memory Evaluation
records.reason: MEME benchmarks agent memory systems on six multi-entity/evolving tasks (Cascade, Absence, Deletion) over 100 controlled episodes, finding dependency-reasoning collapse across paradigms; an evaluation of agent memory behavior, not an inference technique.

records.title: CD-LoRA: Consistency-Driven Low-Rank Adaptation for Multi-Task Fine-Tuning
records.reason: CD-LoRA removes routers from multi-adapter LoRA and aligns task representations in a shared low-rank space to fix a training-inference routing discrepancy in multi-task fine-tuning; despite the word inference, the contribution is PEFT training stability, not inference systems.

records.title: 17.3 ARIES and REGULUS: A Unified and Scalable hardware–software co-designed NPU SoC Family for On-Device and On-Premises Multimodal Inference
records.reason: ARIES/REGULUS is a silicon-proven NPU SoC family for on-device and on-premises multimodal inference spanning vision to LLMs, with unified cross-chip scaling, bound- and distribution-aware mixed-precision quantization and piecewise-linear activation handling, showing near-linear performance scaling and high power/bandwidth efficiency in measurements.

records.title: Linear Attention for Joint Power Optimization and User-Centric Clustering in Cell-Free Networks
records.reason: Uses a lightweight transformer with customized linear attention to jointly predict AP clustering and power allocation from spatial coordinates in user-centric cell-free massive MIMO networks; a wireless-network optimization application, not LLM inference.

records.title: Diff-ES: Stage-wise Structural Diffusion Pruning via Evolutionary Search
records.reason: Diff-ES searches stage-wise sparsity schedules for diffusion models by evolutionary search and executes them via memory-efficient weight routing without duplicating pruned models, achieving wall-clock speedups on DiT/SDXL; it is inference-oriented structured pruning, but for image diffusion models rather than LLMs.

records.title: CraniMem: Cranial Inspired Gated and Bounded Memory for Agentic Systems
records.reason: CraniMem gives LLM agents a gated bounded episodic buffer plus a long-term knowledge graph with scheduled consolidation, improving robustness over RAG/Mem0 on long-horizon benchmarks under noise; an agent memory-management design, not model inference.

records.title: Sink vs. diagonal patterns as mechanisms for attention switch and oversmoothing prevention
records.reason: Provides a theoretical analysis of attention sink versus diagonal patterns, proving conditions for oversmoothing prevention and an equivalence between sinks and hard attention switch in pretrained transformers; attention theory without an inference mechanism, kernel, or measured system effect.

records.title: Self-Correcting Long-Horizon Search Agents via Tree-Structured Memory
records.reason: ReTree maintains a bounded per-step reasoning context for search agents as an evidence tree with source-linked summaries, revising branches when new evidence contradicts earlier claims; context management for agent accuracy, not an inference-system contribution.

records.title: Mitigating Object Hallucination via Concentric Causal Attention
records.reason: Concentric Causal Attention reorders visual-token positions to counter RoPE long-term decay and reduce object hallucination in large vision-language models; the goal is generation factuality on hallucination benchmarks, with no inference efficiency or serving mechanism.

records.title: Hardware Acceleration of Fully Quantized BERT for Efficient Natural Language Processing
records.reason: FQ-BERT fully quantizes BERT weights, activations, softmax, layer normalization and intermediates for an FPGA accelerator on ZCU102/ZCU111, achieving 7.94x weight compression and 3.18 fps/W (28.91x over CPU, 12.72x over GPU); a concrete quantization-plus-hardware contribution to Transformer inference on edge devices.

records.title: A Lightweight Semantic Segmentation Network Based on Self-Attention Mechanism and State Space Model for Efficient Urban Scene Segmentation
records.reason: UMFormer combines self-attention and a Mamba state-space model in an encoder-decoder network for remote-sensing urban scene semantic segmentation; a vision application model whose efficiency claims serve segmentation accuracy, not LLM inference.
